name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2016-03-02.11.2) introduced by Liberal Senator [George Brandis](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/george_brandis): > *That a motion to exempt these bills from the bills cut-off order may be moved immediately and determined without amendment or debate.* This motion is effectively an attempt by Senator Brandis to speed things up so that the bill can be considered faster.
